This is just another reason why this administration must be held accountable by a Republican House and Senate.
Peter,

The President recently canceled a 1-million-plus acre oil lease in Alaska. That is tragic considering that gas prices are the highest they’ve ever been. **In 2022, there is absolutely no reason the United States should not be energy independent.**

We’re home to the most technologically innovative companies in the world and we can extract oil without harming the surrounding environment. President Biden owns these exorbitant gas prices - and no one else.

**While canceling an oil lease is unfortunate** , what’s shameful is that while he’s declaring U.S. energy off limits, he’s making a deal in Venezuela to import more than 1 million barrels of oil PER DAY.

Yep - you read that right **In March, President Biden sent members of his administration to Caracas Venezuela to make a deal with dictator Nicolas Maduro for oil that we don’t need.**

This is just another reason why this administration must be held accountable by a Republican House and Senate.

| | | Dear Peter,

It’s taken a few days to sit with the sadness and anger I feel from the Uvalde massacre of innocent children and teachers, to be able to communicate about this tragedy. As a parent, the pain, devastation and unrelenting sorrow and loss these families are now living with for the rest of their lives is unimaginable.

_**We can put a stop to the tragedies taking the lives of our loved ones.**_

But Republicans in the Senate have refused to act. They hide behind their self-serving rhetoric that “now is not the time to make this political.” In fact they have made this tragedy political by hiding behind that hollow excuse, to protect themselves from any action that would anger the NRA.

As an individual, and as a candidate for Congress, I truly believe in, and have practiced reaching “across the aisle” to work with those who hold beliefs different from my own. But the time for patience has long since passed.

If we believe that our government should protect life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness, then we _must act_ in the face of this epidemic of violence. It is simply unconscionable that a major political party continues to do nothing in the aftermath of the deaths of 19 school children at the hands of an AR-15-wielding teenager. Now is precisely the time for politicians to **do their jobs.**

Running for office is fundamentally about leadership and having the courage to stand up and do what’s right. Passing meaningful gun control in this country is what’s right and what will save thousands of lives. As your next Congresswoman, and as an Army veteran, I will lead boldly on this issue and do everything I can to pass gun control legislation the overwhelming majority of Americans want.

I am honored to be a Moms Demand Action “2022 Gun Sense Candidate” and I will not rest until we protect innocent lives.
---
| Onward–

Emily Beach

Peter, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=aa0d82ddea824bf4ba04bf65dc147d03&_e=4R3QFZaxLvW7p4fyjm0xWuykuN9MxjIGm_C3XEZVPIo3IWzRupmTvczySZG92US1oaMZBmriyJUkTUzoOUiOXwLZPykhzBKjs2lnrR7a0PajqmeN_-l8MatuuB_eW0vsF7yGwVapvUBoveFHnWrpEfu-RJLHpHwuXTRJbcquyrzI6xgXX-rg89e5Qqddv8rtwj-FpIkkaXgK33PSfl8VUIVpR2k6Kcedz9R0h_5kIr5HB8stbMbhzvcMwhzuX0mDKvBKIZhVK9BxtRCAKn6m_e6mmdaw56SEgo1CI7P8ZCCPywwc4DAlT4G-CnIpnRHCIwEVJ2dgNcmGZaLbhFHkyl5SiT8eYgrghqKVd2vafRk%3D)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=aa0d82ddea824bf4ba04bf65dc147d03&_e=4R3QFZaxLvW7p4fyjm0xWuykuN9MxjIGm_C3XEZVPIo3IWzRupmTvczySZG92US1oaMZBmriyJUkTUzoOUiOXwLZPykhzBKjs2lnrR7a0PajqmeN_-l8MatuuB_eW0vsF7yGwVapvUBoveFHnWrpEUdW5StZXM1ssvRcrE853NxmzLKjTexpjjOAzQ29cghnygvu0aJV5rSAU0TxUoD5PX8y27j7Pqt-b2_0t7Kl_MX1XVUhMi6oHrdZ2TXGe8NgZbGHaYRI2JTDK3EIHK34s_x5RRloeS-3l7ADc-zWxb_7mHqMSM4WssTr_8QxHYTsWYKIZxAcZJ7Zqjj54oV-HxlrCIjfNu3UpdeUOPhiB7w%3D)

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=aa0d82ddea824bf4ba04bf65dc147d03&_e=4R3QFZaxLvW7p4fyjm0xWuykuN9MxjIGm_C3XEZVPIo3IWzRupmTvczySZG92US1oaMZBmriyJUkTUzoOUiOXwLZPykhzBKjs2lnrR7a0PajqmeN_-l8MatuuB_eW0vsF7yGwVapvUBoveFHnWrpESvObUWpC_qcK95UIMSIt6eVeNukujgofjsZvdb1-SrOQTW9oFs_BoGsR-AFxa9NHytaaUqSyKP_lnzAYmDDjTfjarAvLanX6tCJtIn5951YywpqxCZEfEetg0vL5Cu7gwVI6uHHoCBxQNVbXRQJcmOHwqA4sygOG1rOkF5CXiAYpJUNWzjIP6ObsYe5m0RDCcxHDRLnYQgqWBLi5wGqsl4%3D) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day — this year and every year — please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Peter, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=aa0d82ddea824bf4ba04bf65dc147d03&_e=4R3QFZaxLvW7p4fyjm0xWuykuN9MxjIGm_C3XEZVPIo3IWzRupmTvczySZG92US1oaMZBmriyJUkTUzoOUiOXwLZPykhzBKjs2lnrR7a0PajqmeN_-l8MatuuB_eW0vsF7yGwVapvUBoveFHnWrpERREZuDzhxvWR6V-YzLtJxiFA6drTxpdr4z907_KLVGKRP738yflaIQtNIxciJ8KGzE0m9DgcoBCta6w5BWFRWo5x7lIbQOKmj6p7pARLQXqRUNM2ah6LgiFPnWK0hy-tzd8NoVvMBAtnA1-AzrP_ZQg2pf1Sk9emU0xzddgb5PjRncCzHnKhf1_WGghk6KU2pKWJw0lKJBKMgnk3HubQSY%3D)

Gary Sinise

name: Great America Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6063%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=N88uluQNWxChuzefyyFiEQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62625%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aiQs3ml%2b%2fJ95%2bzL80WHrwg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62626%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eCXxmQTZDAGVezbFmeDuIw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62626%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eCXxmQTZDAGVezbFmeDuIw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z81vsj3p2b5d3soqthnnpcce65n8msir5sr69640_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor2c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t3561qncp5gs5p6asrkcjib1c9n6lhjdc30s6r6fcrhcjh6acpkcdr69c5kserrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p36phh6sqr8dtie9j38o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5trmop7ugdd5f4obqaqp80289hevbv0k5ue59p0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor2c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4cknf1qpfchkbfdluo9e0oitv5f3h54tl21vgfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor2c1h2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2ire34r4ujjlvvg3o413r9de50cvup8oue348o8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor2c1h2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrhcc361rumm26pauc3hposa0n4hn17eaiplq6j8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor4cth2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3jitepbnjl2skpha5o9muh5po4bibh0gci2io1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor4cth2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1ecpr2193q43ar1b35p6ibi9341ab4jgrlse3a0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor4cth2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn1q35a1us0jh8mvesmc19bbtn1nsbtb97siprbg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor4clh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8sqjhirj50t0969mitfbrj8b6ckchkjrpviguig_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdgmaor4clh2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f9b989a0351e4996bb279cc06e515aa0&_e=yjOHJWrhVPE5RU5BfB9lpF97FRBztzwOhb_FyjPTjotD9CoCt6MOmiErl-eouWKHKW5G_knw8WDKSGVSuWI36oRvPlhEN7A2aG7gNSAet5MNugJcIoFksLCWhgOJVpVfkky8IG-ydlKV70bb81FJ0CAhuKf5tV9XW59Eg8qW3SJr8lClGhzJvQa01CBFXuESNdGotE5UFVjxxjXpzp9CcyQbN-3ZoFG9TN5YA4lMVROP3vM1AysN-nDAQPSS3X8R8xHYzOqhzgZG-VgjbvtzIAVC4Oxb2iuBDgupz8O9RmEd1Of-HQ3C4NuB8GaoQvcPu6KReyf7xawNbUcefUIw9FDPiWGfK0E_liyTRzUnLAA%3D)

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9032%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=V83sz2A10hqjQnx9EvEbnw&sysid=1)

This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. name: Alex Coronado
subject: Mike's appearance at Anaheim City Hall
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ortega For Congress
body:
Friends,

It will come as no surprise to you, but Mike Ortega is already holding corrupt elected leaders accountable.

This week, amid the FBI corruption probe into former (he resigned earlier this week) Anaheim Mayor Harry Sidhu, Mike went to City Hall alongside his fellow Anaheim residents to let those that were working with Sidhu know: enough is enough.

If you haven't seen, please check out his appearance here: Click here to watch!

Furthermore, Mike issued a formal statement on the matter:

“This week has been a challenging time for Anaheim, CA-46, and Orange County. The FBI probe into Harry Sidhu’s corruption has shed light on improper dealings between local politicians and influential business leaders. Implicated in the investigation are several current and former members of the Anaheim City Council, Anaheim Chamber of Commerce, Angels Baseball and Disneyland Resort. This Tuesday, I joined fellow residents of Anaheim to call on the city to void the stadium deal. We called for an open investigation into all City Council members’ campaign finances and related decisions made on behalf of the City Government.

We have learned that this “cabal” of business and political leaders engaged in plans on how to exploit the taxpayers of Anaheim to personally profit from major city decisions. The brazen corruption shocked the collective consciousness of people from my district. However, this is not a unique story. Harry Sidhu was simply a terrible criminal and made the FBI investigation easy to capture the damning evidence.

On a statewide and national level this corruption is a normal part of American politics. Members of both parties accept campaign contributions and independent expenditures from dark money PACs on a regular basis. This is why our campaign, along with other grassroots campaigns across the county, have refused to accept corporate money. It is why I will fight to abolish Citizens United and curtail the influence that special interests have over our elected leaders.

The current representative for CA-46 Lou Correa (D) has been silent in condemning the pay-for-play politics we’ve seen in Anaheim this week. The “Homegrown Leadership” he claims to espouse is absent. I suspect it is because of the shared donor base and relationships he has with those implicated in the FBI probe. This includes his protégé and endorsee, Councilmember Avelino Valencia. When we put Lou’s legislative history under a microscope, we find that his opposition to universal healthcare and single-payer prescription drug pricing is in direct conflict with his deep financial ties to Big Pharma.

Residents in this district and across the country are ready for change. Career politicians that are beholden to their corporate donors are unpopular amongst voters. This election season we must say enough is enough. We have to vote for representatives who will fight for the residents and families of our communities and not big-money donors. I call upon the community that if we want a better future for our children, we need to say NO to corporate politicians. I ask that this June 7th you vote for me, Mike Ortega, for a better OC.”

___________________________

In case you missed it, please check out our campaign video and share on social media and with with friends, family: https://youtu.be/kclhy8qmjS4
____________________________

Yours In Solidarity,

Alex Coronado

Campaign Manager

| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001a6wS17o7ZOl4xXFCmygvSPce39MzKVwSCemW83yhgIjC3FlmXv99YtGx2rb17y8wv9Jy_ZUcVRbldMVIDJsY8hJgc7s48taakXh51Qy-aQ8jgMk9XVZynBt51JOzhqOPaU74_MnBQAM=&c=_jj1x9e4PtCPitSoCwTQMrxwUyZgIoGgIiAUu1Z9lvUMJDAq2q8Tig==&ch=Ag05MrwXSnpxfQPpFZILrfASo6mwhxYL4i5M07zFmgZ_UN_4V71pjA==)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE May 27th, 2022
Former 6th District Candidate, Combat Vet Endorses Jake Evans

---
|
---
| Former 6th District Republican candidate, Byron Gatewood, a war combat veteran and Cobb County small business owner, today encouraged his friends and supporters to join him in supporting Jake Evans in the Republican runoff. "As the only combat veteran in the Georgia 6th District race, I appreciate the respect that Jake Evans has for our military," Gatewood said. "Jake will always support our troops, not only giving them what they need to defend our country, but also stopping endless wars. I ran for Congress because, like Jake, I know America is worth fighting for. Now that my campaign has come to an end, I'm proud to support Jake in this runoff. He's the conservative we need fighting for us to stop the radical Biden/Pelosi agenda." Jake said Gatewood's support continues the momentum the campaign has going into the runoff. "Byron was an inspiring candidate because his commitment to serve his community and nation is beyond question," Jake said. "I appreciate his friendship and support as we fight to Save America from the reckless policies of the Biden administration and Democratic Congress."

---

| GA-10 Resident and Former Georgia Insurance Commissioner Ralph Hudgens Endorses Vernon Jones For Congress
---
|
---
| Madison, GA (05/27/2022) - On Friday, Madison County resident and former Georgia Insurance Commissioner Ralph T. Hudgens endorsed Vernon Jones to serve as the next Congressman for Georgia's 10th Congressional District.

"I am proud to join President Trump and my neighbors in endorsing Vernon Jones to be the next Congressman for Georgia's 10th Congressional District. Vernon is the conservative warrior I trust to beat back the Radical Left, take on the Biden Administration, and fight for the America First agenda," said former Insurance Commissioner Ralph T. Hudgens.

"It is an honor to have earned the trust and confidence of Commissioner Hudgens in my campaign to put America First, fight for Georgia families, and build back what Joe Biden broke. Our campaign continues to grow stronger by the day," said Vernon Jones, Trump-endorsed candidate for Congress.

From 2011-2019, Ralph Hudgens served as Georgia Insurance Commissioner. Prior to serving as Insurance Commissioner, Hudgens served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 1996-2002 and the Georgia State Senate from 2003-2011.

| Vernon Jones is running for Georgia's 10th Congressional District. He is a former member of the GA House of Representatives (1993-2001, 2017-2021) and former Chief Executive Officer of DeKalb County, GA. A former Democrat, Jones officially switched parties in January 2021 after endorsing Donald J. Trump for President and speaking at the 2020 Republican National Convention. The proud Republican is now running in GA10, as a Pro-Trump candidate who will fight for free and fair elections, and always put Georgia and America First.

name: Chris Bye
subject: Last Push
body:
Team- I cannot express my thankfulness in your support. We are doing way
better than I ever expected. In using terms of political success, I am
getting a supporting vote for pennies compared to other candidates.
That is in huge part due to you all.

I would ask in these last few days there are roughly 30-40% of the primary
ballots still floating around out there and there are newly arrived folks,
especially military service members. I would ask you to share our website
ItsTimeAlaska.com to four or more people encouraging them to consider
voting for us.

I really would like veterans to get after the Active Duty vote. These men
and women often do not participate because they realize they are transients
but their vote is critical. We've been at key off post intersections at
5:45 AM to encourage their voting. Engage them off post. Their hair cuts
and mannerisms give them away. Be Brave and engage, these men and women
are worth it.

Active duty, please do not violate the Hatch Act. Your careers as leaders
hinge on you remaining agnostic in the electoral process so as not to
influence your subordinates. DoD Directive 1344.10 lays out what you can
and cannot. You can however sport a bumper sticker. And send "letters to
the editor" voicing your opinions.

As always stay Brave and be Encouraging. There is enough trash talking
with the political pundits and celebs. Let's offer the political
disinclined and disillusioned something different.

Friend, Marco Rubio is attacking my 27 years of law enforcement service, so I'm reaching out to set the record straight.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is, some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need more resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

Thank you for joining this grassroots movement.

Chief Val Demings

subject: Fight like hell
body:
Derek:
When I was President of Planned Parenthood, I learned a crucial lesson about anti-choice extremists: They want activists like you and me to sit down, shut up, and give up – because they’re TERRIFIED of our power if we act together.
They desperately want us to sit silently, obediently as the Supreme Court rolls back women’s rights 50 years and puts GOP politicians in control of our bodies and health care.
They want us to surrender the Senate, so they can pass a nationwide abortion ban punishing women from coast to coast. Well, that is NOT going to happen – we’re ready to fight like hell to stop them!
We have the power to save our Democratic Senate majority and women’s rights – but only if we step up for Catherine Cortez Masto right now! Her race will decide Senate control, but she’s 3 points behind in the polls and Mitch McConnell and his super PAC are spending $18 MILLION on attack ads against her. She needs to hit her emergency goal tonight or it will be too late.
That’s why I promised Catherine I would help hit her emergency goal before tonight’s deadline. Dear fellow American, Inflation is on the rise in America. And there’s no sign of it slowing down. In February, consumer prices rose 7.9 percent—the highest annual inflation rate increase since January 1982. Economic historian John Steele Gordon discussed inflation in a recent issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty. And he noted that adding trillions more to the national debt is not the solution. In fact, it will only make the problem worse. Nevertheless, support for socialism and other ideologies destructive of the free market also appears to be on the rise in our country, especially among younger Americans. That’s why you’re receiving this email today. Hillsdale College seeks to understand more clearly what Americans think about our nation’s economy and the inflation we’re experiencing. And I’m hoping you can help by completing our **National Survey on Inflation in the United States** using the secure link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z12sht4u2ktok8i9u80gn0kifsd45k3cbjnq2fv8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cdim6ob6c5h2bs)** The survey will take you only a few minutes to complete. body:
Derrick Van Orden has no place in Congress.

| Peter,

First things first, I wanted to check in with you on our progress towards this month’s $15,000 fundraising goal. After Deb reached out yesterday, we saw a surge of support! However, we can’t let up now if we’re going to meet this target.

**[I need to ask right away if you can make your first donation to our team to keep our fundraising on track >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45791881/347521667/-1644800166?refcode=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ms=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWQwYmQ0ZS1jNWRkLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yOEVXqwKwAuy3JsrhKEipiL6KwPETBj-a7o0VHeWGiM=)** | ****[RUSH A DONATION >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45791882/347521675/-1644800166?refcode=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ms=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWQwYmQ0ZS1jNWRkLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yOEVXqwKwAuy3JsrhKEipiL6KwPETBj-a7o0VHeWGiM=)****
---
Next, I’m passing along a recent headline we saw - the article featured our opponent, Derrick Van Orden, and highlighted the stakes of this race:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45791883/347521676/-1644800166?refcode=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ms=ea.91d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWQwYmQ0ZS1jNWRkLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yOEVXqwKwAuy3JsrhKEipiL6KwPETBj-a7o0VHeWGiM=)
_The Atlantic_ is right: Van Orden is a wackadoodle. **He’s also _dangerous_ , and we can’t afford to forget it.**

❌ Van Orden attended the January 6th insurrection. He doesn’t have the respect for our democracy a representative needs.

❌ He would roll women’s rights backwards if given the chance and is vehemently opposed to reproductive rights.

❌ He boldly admitted to sexually harassing female officers while in the Navy. This demonstrates disdain for regulations and lack of respect for women.

Peter, we cannot allow Derrick Van Orden to get anywhere near Congress - he already did enough damage when he was there on January 6th. **Unlike Van Orden, Deb’s not in this race to gain power for herself. subject: Gun violence is rampant. We must act!

Dear Peter,

**I’m tired and fed up.** Too many times we've seen the same thoughts and prayers be issued by politicians around the country in the face of all parents' nightmares. When I drop my kids off at school I want them thinking about math and science, what's going on with their friends, and building towards a bright future--not looking over their shoulder preparing for a mass shooting.
**Did you know that we've had over 200+ mass shootings in 2022 alone? ****Enough is enough.**
Republican leaders across the country offer no solutions, no legislation, and no answers on how we can end this epidemic. While we offer sensible and meaningful policy alternatives, the other side continues to take contributions and directions from the NRA to enact policies that endanger our children.
**Enough is enough.**
Elections have consequences and for too long we've let out-of-state, out-of-touch ideologies lead our state into this dark place. Every session we hear from victims of gun violence beg us for action from around Tennessee, only to see them be met by the national Republican/NRA talking points that lead to the same outcomes.** **
**Enough is enough.**
Our state, community, and country have been hurting for far too long. From Johnson City to Memphis, it's time to send a message. **Enough is enough.** **It's time for results in Tennessee. **

Thank you,

Caucus Chairman, Rep. Vincent Dixie
Tennessee House Democratic Caucus

| | Dear Peter, Our neighbors to the south in California are blazing a trail when it comes to regulating the automobile industry––leading the way for our region and the country since the 1970s. Yet cars remain the largest source of greenhouse gas pollution in California and here in Oregon. Right now the California Air Resources Board (or CARB) is considering the Advanced Clean Cars II Rules creating a significant opportunity to move the needle in the deepening climate crisis. Unfortunately the current version of the rules doesn’t go far enough. We need your help to ensure that the rules are as strong as possible––setting a high standard not for California but paving the way for the surrounding states as well. **[Will you take action to urge California’s air quality regulators to demand the Advanced Clean Cars II Rules be strengthened?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45792445/347523317/-941733799?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4ZDBiZDRlLWM1ZGQtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vxWkGG3rQTL87A0Xileel87p9YQKe_6ZBx9a5uvVAUA=&emci=ea5ec254-53dc-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=78d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=2107230)** California is such a large state that when they pass regulation that dramatically increases fuel standards it forces the entire car industry to shift. Oregon benefits from California’s strong clean car rules, which is why we urge you to take action today urging CARB to strengthen the Advanced Clean Cars II Rules. The current rules will not enable California to meet its climate goals. Under the rules as they are currently written, the state would not be able to meet its goal of phasing out the sale of new gas cars by 2035. _Additionally, the rules fail to guarantee Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC) and low income communities will be able to afford pollution-free vehicles._ **[Will you urge CARB to strengthen the Advanced Clean Car II Rules and include strong equity standards to ensure no one is left behind as we transition to clean vehicles](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45792447/347523319/-941733799?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4ZDBiZDRlLWM1ZGQtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vxWkGG3rQTL87A0Xileel87p9YQKe_6ZBx9a5uvVAUA=&emci=ea5ec254-53dc-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=78d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=2107230)?** We have drafted a sample letter for you to use, but feel free to customize the message––the important thing is that you urge CARB to strengthen the rules and ensure equitable access to clean cars during this crucial transition. Climate change is one of the most urgent issues of our time and we need bold leadership from California to help make a pollution free transportation system possible for all of us on the urgent timeline required. **[CARB has extended their public comment period to May 31st so it’s urgent that you act right away!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45792450/347523329/-941733799?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4ZDBiZDRlLWM1ZGQtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vxWkGG3rQTL87A0Xileel87p9YQKe_6ZBx9a5uvVAUA=&emci=ea5ec254-53dc-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=78d0bd4e-c5dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,

Julia DeGraw

body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
As we enter the final stretch of this competitive Primary Race, I’m reaching out to personally ask you to join my team as a volunteer [https://www.franchot.com/action] .
Over the past few months, my incredible field team has been hard at work recruiting volunteers to help reach thousands of voters in all corners of the state – and I’m proud to tell you that their efforts have been paying off. Recent polls have confirmed that our campaign has a strong lead over the rest of the field, and I have no doubt that with your help, we can pull ahead even further in the weeks to come.
https://www.franchot.com/action [https://www.franchot.com/action]
Every weekend from now to Election Day, Team Franchot volunteers will continue to build on our momentum by speaking with voters on neighborhood main streets, at parks and parades, and in coffee shops and restaurants. House by house, street by street, and neighborhood by neighborhood, we’re building the critical mass of support needed to win this election and change the way that government does business. We need all the help we can get, so invite your friends and neighbors to join us!
The stakes in this election are too high to sit out on the sidelines. From combating climate change, to building world-class public transit, to tackling the student debt crisis and much more, we have an exciting opportunity to lift our communities into the high quality of life that they deserve. Click here to volunteer with my team, and let’s get it done. [https://www.franchot.com/action]
I can’t wait to see you on the campaign trail!
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

Hi friends, In less than two weeks from now, voters across New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district will make their voices heard in the primary election and determine who will take on far-right Rep. Yvette Herrell in the November general election. **And less than one week from now, our campaign faces our final end-of-month deadline before this major milestone.** [**Before I ask if you’ll chip in to help us reach our goal, I hope you’ll let me explain why your contribution matters now more than ever.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45796005/347537108/-1530593628?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220527eom2_gv_od_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2VmYzM4NS1jOWRkLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=clC-8L9waREoxA85wC2EKu97CLgyewt23O-2iJLI3VE=) Since Herrell flipped this seat from blue to red in 2020, she’s gone on to oppose countless legislative solutions to problems facing our district. She voted:
* AGAINST massive investments in infrastructure and job creation
* AGAINST stronger voting rights
* AGAINST action on climate
* AGAINST lower drug prices and capping the cost of insulin
* AGAINST funding to relieve the baby formula shortage
* AGAINST our reproductive rights

Her first vote in Congress was against confirming the presidential election results, and from there, she’s pushed further lies about the election and dangerous conspiracy theories about COVID-19, and buddied up with other Republican extremists like Matt Gaetz and Marjorie Taylor Greene. Herrell is far too extreme for NM-02 — but the good news is, she’s the only remaining Republican representative for New Mexico in Congress, and redistricting has given us a massive opportunity to flip this seat. **Our race has been rated a toss-up by Cook Political Report, and we’re one of the DCCC’s critical Red to Blue campaigns needed to defend our House majority.** Together, we can take this seat back, save Congress from a Republican takeover, and start passing more solutions to the issues our communities face every day. [**We have less than two weeks to spread the word about our campaign before the primary. Your support has fueled us to this point, and I am so grateful. Will you help us keep up our momentum to the June 7 primary by pitching in whatever you can today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45796006/347537109/-1530593628?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220527eom2_gv_od_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2VmYzM4NS1jOWRkLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=clC-8L9waREoxA85wC2EKu97CLgyewt23O-2iJLI3VE=) | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...
From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. ](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNj7tqxDAURL_G7mykK1vyFi4CYZvgVIGUQr663hXRw0gy-f3YKVIHppqB4Rw7W7SGY-tmYABsBMXZcGOyB75OdrMjEuOKkWoGZjzl2mfaj9U7NLGa8rWljNRjCu1zZrTy2wAjTRK4UpPCwYzCcLEaiUay9nPRi3Hexce7CTTnuulcdA56TTFS7mo2sZyPQY8dqA5A89bPz1r30oiXBu5nCuGRqc_pcRBhiik4LBfANYs7OtuI1-XtQ4LgXDQg6a8RijHe5tnu3857V-Ql9Qgn0a9A_RfQD5WCYfw) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she’s discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I’ve found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ our economy into something we didn’t vote on... didn’t ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we’re about to see a stranger, more extreme ‘new normal’ in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead.”** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there’s no cost to watch. **_My Original Message:_**

Hi there,

Join the fight for freedom!

But the House Freedom Fund has their backs. It's our mission to ensure Jordan, Biggs, and Perry win their re-elections.

Good morning ,
From Uvalde to Pennsylvania, and with California and Buffalo still on our minds, we are deeply saddened by the routine violence that happens every single day in Pennsylvania and across the country. Whether in mass shootings, in gun violence in our own neighborhoods, in acts of racist hate, or in domestic violence, gun violence impacts all our lives.
The carnage we are witnessing in Uvalde happens on a consistent basis with each passing week and month in communities across the Commonwealth, and our elected leaders must work with urgency to address it.
This is an important reminder that all elections have consequences, which is why we must continue to fight for policies that directly affect our communities every day, long after the news cycle moves on.
We don't need thoughts and prayers, we need legislation from those in power. We need change. We need to vote our values. Show your solidarity to the people of Texas by making a donation to CeaseFire PA [https://ceasefirepa.salsalabs.org/220525TXGunSense/index.html?fbclid=IwAR1fMrZS009C3JH2mJ1ZHYPgP35TXSe9gb1ZgDV5CVVJzomv-05N1m-JogE] .

Peter, Last week President Biden and Democrats took the necessary steps to combat the baby formula shortage. I’m thankful that President Biden invoked his emergency powers under the Defense Production Act to boost the production of baby formula and increase imports to alleviate the shortage — I know millions of families are thankful too. As a pediatrician, it’s terrifying that infants could potentially go without the nutrition they need to grow. This shortage has been affecting millions of families, but particularly low-income, working families who have less access to baby formula to begin with. I’ve had mothers come into my clinic who are unable to afford baby formula or find it. No parent should ever see their child go hungry. I’ve done what any healthcare provider would do by giving out samples to help them get the vital nutrients their babies need — but I know more action is needed. That’s why I’m also thankful that Democrats have put forth two bills to help expand access to low-income families who rely on WIC to purchase their baby formula and boost the workforce in formula production. Unsurprisingly, the only members in Congress who opposed these bills were GOP extremists. My opponent, Lori Saine, looks up to one of these GOP extremists, Rep. Boebert, and would have voted against this bill as well if given the chance. What I’m up against is truly alarming. Peter, in Congress, I promise to fight for working families in CO-08 and advocate for their well-being unlike my extremist opponent. | | **A Message From Bill McSwain **
---
| Dear Friends:

I wanted to thank you for your wonderful support of my campaign for Governor. Despite the outcome, the campaign was one of the greatest experiences of my life. My heart is full of gratitude for all of the amazing Pennsylvanians I was able to meet all across our Commonwealth.

I got into this race because I love Pennsylvania, and after this campaign I love it even more.

Behind every hand that I was honored to shake in the campaign was a person, a family, a neighborhood, and a community. No matter what corner of the Commonwealth I traveled to, I was always inspired by the solid core of goodness that permeates Pennsylvania. That is what drove me to run for office in the first place – and drove me to press on and never give up. There was no quit in me, because there is no quit in Pennsylvanians.

The law abiding, freedom loving, hardworking Pennsylvanians will always define our state – and our values will endure and outlast any campaign.

I will continue to stay involved in public and community service to make Pennsylvania the greatest place in the country to live, work, and raise a family. That’s the commitment that our Commonwealth's challenges demand, and that the people of Pennsylvania deserve.

Part of that is my personal commitment to all of you. I can’t thank you enough for encouraging me, and for your steadfast support throughout this journey. I promise that I will always strive to be worthy of your trust, and that I will always be loyal to you and our ideals.

Thank you, and God Bless you.

Your friend,

Bill McSwain

subject: We must take care of one another
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ANN ROE FOR CONGRESS Ann Roe for Congress
body:
|
---
Friends, I have lost so many hours of sleep this week. My heart absolutely breaks for the victims and their families in Texas. Unfortunately, our community knows exactly how painful and shattering these acts of senseless violence can be, and the trauma that will live on. In this dark moment, we must take care of one another.

And once we've taken time to process and grieve, we need to get angry – and turn that anger into action.

I am angry about the continued inaction regarding gun control. Angry that Bryan Steil _still_ has not acknowledged such a tragic loss of young lives. I am angry that something as simple and serious as _saving lives_ is not enough for Bryan to vote with a conscience instead of an agenda.

**I am angry that every failed bill results in the loss of more innocent lives.**

Despite the inaction and complacency, we cannot stop fighting for increased background checks, closing loopholes, and supporting policies proven to prevent mass shootings based on research from groups like Everytown, _not_ gun lobbies.

Friends, this is important. **Herschel Walker (R) is now officially the GOP nominee for Senate here in Georgia, meaning he and I will be facing off this November.**
With the entire GOP establishment behind Walker, keeping this seat and the Senate blue will come down to your grassroots support. **So I’m urgently asking:[Will you split $5 or more right now between my campaign and Cheri Beasley’s so we can keep Georgia and the Senate blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-warnock-split?refcode=em220527-1-ma&refcode2=945.357359.t85FdY&t=1&akid=945%2E357359%2Et85FdY)

body:
Rep. David Trone’s identity crisis | | | |
---
|
---
| | | **Dear Peter,**

Instead of focusing on his constituents, Rep. David Trone continues to run his multi-billion dollar business while “serving” in Congress – all while lining his pockets and filling his campaign war-chest.

If that's what you want in a representative, then Trone is your guy!** But let’s be clear: It’s not.**

[**If you want your representative to put our district first, before their own financial interests, I need to win this race. Please donate $50, $100, $250, $1000, or anything you can today.**](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=cafc1ebedd&e=0faa9de128)
---
| Rep. David Trone hands out lots of cash to, as he says, [“buy access.”](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=774a582970&e=0faa9de128) Often, this cash helped elect anti-choice and anti-democracy extremists on the far right, such as Texas Governor Abbott, leading the fight against women’s reproductive choice and voting rights, and Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, who is aligned with the extremist NRA agenda.

Get this: When a person makes a political donation, they are required to list an occupation and employer. **Over one hundred times while serving in Congress, and as recently as last month, Rep. Trone continues to list his employer as Total Wine** – his multi-billion dollar business empire that he runs while serving in the U.S. House of Representatives.

**Is Rep. David Trone having an identity crisis? Does he put YOU or his Billion Dollar Business first?**

Call me old fashioned, but **_I believe our Member of Congress should only focus on representing the people – not on building their own wealth._** A Congressional salary is high enough!

Here’s what I’ve heard from people I’ve met in our community: Rep. Trone sweeps in in the last couple weeks before the election, drops millions of his own dollars to flood you with ads, mail, and whatever appeals for your vote he can muster, and expects this to be enough.

The problem is, with as much money as he has, sometimes this IS enough to buy an election. My friends – we can’t let this happen! **We need LESS pay-to-play in Washington, not more. **

These are the most critical weeks before the election, before any ballots are mailed and before most people have made up their minds. **Your donations, time, and energy will be the difference and we _must_ stand up to Rep. Trone’s onslaught of money.**

I want to repeat: **you are the difference in this campaign.** I need you behind me if I am going to defeat David Trone, one of the very wealthiest members of Congress.

[**Please, if you can, chip in $25, $50, $100, or anything at all. **](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=2dce524f06&e=0faa9de128)

We can win this, but I need your help. Thank you.

Sincerely,
Ben

body:

---
Which is the greater shame? That our elected leaders continue to offer shallow condolences to grieving families rather than take action, or that our children go to school in fear of their lives every day?

In the wake of Tuesday’s tragic massacre at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, TX, our Congressman said, “There are no words” – and he’s right.

**Our children don’t need words, they need action.** But Dan Newhouse refuses to even discuss gun violence. He won’t consider addressing responsible gun ownership, mental-health and background checks – none of the measures we know could mitigate this violence.

This week, I’ve had meaningful talks with people in our district about responsible gun owners, mental health, and what we can do to truly protect our communities while preserving our constitutional rights.

**That’s how you lead. That’s how you find solutions.**

I’m ashamed to have Newhouse representing me in Congress, and I’m ashamed of the 50 U.S. Senators who refuse to offer a solution or even discuss the violence threatening our communities.

My sincerest prayers are with the families of those killed, and with the entire Uvalde community. I wish their elected leaders had served them better.

– Doug

body:
Peter,

The latest tragedy in the American saga of gun violence: 19 students killed in an elementary school shooting in Uvalde, Texas, with another 17 wounded. This is the latest large mass shooting, following the Buffalo, NY shooting that left 10 dead and 3 wounded on May 14th. Both shooters were only 18 years old, they wore military style tactical gear, and were armed with assault rifles and high capacity magazines. The Uvalde shooter shot 142 bullets and had 60 magazines with him, armed for war.

We have a responsibility to make our country a safer place to live for our children. We must demand that our leaders prioritize our children’s lives over the profits of the gun lobby.

Sign our petition demanding immediate action from Congress to stop this senseless violence. https://act.myngp.com/Forms/3634069541497277184

Our children are counting on us to keep them safe from harm, to put them first, and to support laws which keep dangerous weapons out of schools and out of the wrong hands. Both shooters in these recent mass shootings were only 18. One immediate step that could be taken is raise the age to buy firearms to 21, when they are more mature and have entered adulthood. Our government currently believes those 18-20 are too immature to legally drink alcohol, so the drinking age is 21. Why do we not treat firearms, especially assault rifles, the same way as we treat alcohol? This is one of many, many options available to start tackling the gun violence problem. But Republicans in the Senate stand in the way of any gun reform bill passing Congress.

No parent should ever feel afraid to leave their child at school for the day, and it’s unacceptable that our leaders have accepted these tragic events as the new normal. We can and must do better.

If we continue to stand by and do nothing, our nation’s epidemic of gun violence will only get worse and school shootings will continue to be a daily reality for all of us.

We must demand change to keep our children, and all of us safe. Sign our petition calling on Congress to TAKE ACTION and pass commonsense gun reform NOW. https://act.myngp.com/Forms/3634069541497277184

In solidarity,

Jason Lindsay

---
| | In times of national despair, **it can be difficult to find the right words** to express our feelings.

In times of great tragedy, **it can be challenging to know how, when, or where** to make your voice heard.

But, **when we come together as communities,** our collective voice **pierces through the darkness.** Through our fellow Americans, we can find our voice and **make it heard. **

The **outpour of support** I saw from Utahns to the parents and families of the 19 students and two teachers who were brutally murdered at Robb Elementary on Tuesday **brought me great pause. **

Despite the pain and grief we all experienced this week, **I was deeply encouraged** by our community's ability to **uplift each other's voices, offer words of kindness, and call for action.**

Today, instead of our weekly recap, **I wanted to write to you as my community** and say: **I hear you.**

Your voice is **loud,** your words are **clear,** and I am committed to **finding a path forward.**
---
| |
---
I was at my **grandaughter's kindergarten graduation** when we received the tragic news about the shooting at Robb Elementary.
Seeing the faces of my granddaughter and her peers that day—full of life and excitement—was a **sobering and stark** contrast to what was happening in Uvalde **at that very moment. **
---
| It serves as a reminder that **children everywhere deserve to experience the full breadth of life,** and it's time we elect leaders that have the **courage and commitment to keep our children safe. **

If this week's tragedy has weighed heavily on your heart, as it has mine,**I hope you'll reach out to the people in your community.** We are stronger together, and when we join together under a vision for a better future, **we can make a change. **

As always, thank you for your support. I am with you **today, tomorrow, and for all of the days to come. **

If you'd like to r**ead more about my thoughts** on the tragedy at Robb Elementary, **find my statement[here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=6257d7ec38&e=10c1db3257). **

body:

## Patriots,
On April 20th, we helped launch the South Carolina Freedom Caucus, the 3rd state to join our State Freedom Caucus Network. Below is a Q&A session that we recently did with its chairman, Adam Morgan. We hope you enjoy it.
---
|
---
Representative Adam Morgan speaks before the South Carolina Freedom Caucus at their launch in Columbia, South Carolina, April 20th.
|
## **Q &A: Representative Adam Morgan,
South Carolina Freedom Caucus Chairman**
---
| **Q. As a small business owner, how welcoming and helpful has SC government been in helping you grow your business?**

A. I try not to look to the government to help grow my business. In fact, SC has an addiction to “economic development”—which is basically a benign name for the crony policies of government handouts and picking winners and losers. What the government could do to “help” all SC businesses is get less involved in our business. Abandon government planning—I mean “economic development”—cut taxes, and cut regulations.

**Q. What led you to run for office? What made you decide to be a conservative?**

A. I have a deep love for history and political philosophy. In grade school the exemplars of Adams, Franklin, and Madison inspired me to dream about taking part in our political system. Likewise, icons such as Buckley, Kirk, and statesmen like DeMint and Reagan affected my political leanings. Good parenting likely caused my conservatism. However, the second decisive influence was the radical Leftist culture I experienced in law school. I was scandalized by the lack of respect for our institutions, religious roots, and Western culture. I can accurately say I was more pushed than pulled to the far right.

**Q. What made you want to form a Freedom Caucus in SC?**

A. I saw that our main issue as conservative legislators was organization. Our opponents are well-financed, well-staffed, and in control of the seats of power. We needed to build a strong coalition to support and embolden conservatives at al levels of government. The Freedom Caucus has led that effort on the national stage, and we knew the brand would be a perfect fit to change our state.

**Q. What is the most immediate need in order to expand individual liberty in South Carolina?**

A. Cut government—offensive not defensive action is required.

**Q. How will you go about passing conservative policy in spite of efforts from establishment to promote “the go along to get along” mantra?**

A. By showing leadership and fellow members that we have courage and conviction, and by making it clear to everyone that we are changing the culture.

**Q. How do you plan to fight the “woke” left in your state?**

A. By awakening patriotic Americans to the dire need to protect our institutions, values, and way of life.

**Q.How do you keep each individual member devoted to the fight even when the left and the establishment put pressure on them?**

A. By fostering unity, leading by example to inspire boldness, and providing support for every Caucus member.

**Q. What are some instances of how the left has infiltrated and affected policy in a “red” state like SC?**

A. Our Legislature’s embrace of identity politics is acutely evident in various committee and board appointments. Both in statute and agency regulations we have required appointees to be of a certain gender or race to reach diversity quotas. Additionally, government employees and teachers are subjected to “sensitivity” and other seemingly harmless (yet time wasting) trainings that are in reality woke, Marxist indoctrination.

**Q. What are some policy proposals your caucus will have for the next Legislative Session?**

A. Expand school choice, protect life, cut spending and government regulation, oppose woke policies, and much more.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Patriots, On April 20th, we helped launch the South Carolina Freedom Caucus, the 3rd state to join our State Freedom Caucus Network. Below is a Q&A session that we recently did with its chairman, Adam Morgan. We hope you enjoy it. | Representative Adam Morgan speaks before the South Carolina Freedom Caucus at their launch in Columbia, South Carolina, April 20th. | Q &A: Representative Adam Morgan, South Carolina Freedom Caucus Chairman | Q. As a small business owner, how welcoming and helpful has SC government been in helping you grow your business? A. I try not to look to the government to help grow my business. In fact, SC has an addiction to “economic development”—which is basically a benign name for the crony policies of government handouts and picking winners and losers. What the government could do to “help” all SC businesses is get less involved in our business. Abandon government planning—I mean “economic development”—cut taxes, and cut regulations. Q. What led you to run for office? What made you decide to be a conservative? A. I have a deep love for history and political philosophy. In grade school the exemplars of Adams, Franklin, and Madison inspired me to dream about taking part in our political system. Likewise, icons such as Buckley, Kirk, and statesmen like DeMint and Reagan affected my political leanings. Good parenting likely caused my conservatism. However, the second decisive influence was the radical Leftist culture I experienced in law school. I was scandalized by the lack of respect for our institutions, religious roots, and Western culture. I can accurately say I was more pushed than pulled to the far right. Q. What made you want to form a Freedom Caucus in SC? A. I saw that our main issue as conservative legislators was organization. Our opponents are well-financed, well-staffed, and in control of the seats of power. We needed to build a strong coalition to support and embolden conservatives at al levels of government. The Freedom Caucus has led that effort on the national stage, and we knew the brand would be a perfect fit to change our state. Q. What is the most immediate need in order to expand individual liberty in South Carolina? A. Cut government—offensive not defensive action is required. Q. How will you go about passing conservative policy in spite of efforts from establishment to promote “the go along to get along” mantra? A. By showing leadership and fellow members that we have courage and conviction, and by making it clear to everyone that we are changing the culture. Q. How do you plan to fight the “woke” left in your state? A. By awakening patriotic Americans to the dire need to protect our institutions, values, and way of life. Q.How do you keep each individual member devoted to the fight even when the left and the establishment put pressure on them? A. By fostering unity, leading by example to inspire boldness, and providing support for every Caucus member. Q. What are some instances of how the left has infiltrated and affected policy in a “red” state like SC? A. Our Legislature’s embrace of identity politics is acutely evident in various committee and board appointments. Both in statute and agency regulations we have required appointees to be of a certain gender or race to reach diversity quotas. Additionally, government employees and teachers are subjected to “sensitivity” and other seemingly harmless (yet time wasting) trainings that are in reality woke, Marxist indoctrination. Q. What are some policy proposals your caucus will have for the next Legislative Session? A. Expand school choice, protect life, cut spending and government regulation, oppose woke policies, and much more. | | "CLICK HERE TO DONATE" | | | | | Copyright © 2022 State Freedom Caucus Network, All rights reserved.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: We cannot let this happen!
body:

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Peter, I don't believe the majority of the public really knows what is being taught to our children and grandchildren. They assume they are taught the same lessons we learned growing up--that America is a land of freedom and opportunity where anyone has a chance at success. From what I've seen, this isn't always the case. [**However, I want to know what you 've seen.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60475991:JI73qzoNN:m:1:3317145305:65B50FAED582D765AAC12BACEFF81007:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60475991:JI73qzoNN:m:1:3317145305:65B50FAED582D765AAC12BACEFF81007:r)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ I believe that **children as young as elementary age are being taught to reject our American values.** They are told that our Founding Fathers were massively flawed and that it overshadows the nation they built. They hear that our Constitution is "out of date" and needs to be "modernized." Progressives are rewriting our nation's history and they are doing it with our youngest and most vulnerable. We cannot let this happen! This year I'm going to be meeting with political leaders and educational "experts" across the country. **I 'm going to make sure people know what is really happening in our schools. ** I want to be able to share with them the thoughts of people who are closest to the issue. [**Specifically, I would like to include your thoughts.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60475991:JI73qzoNN:m:1:3317145305:65B50FAED582D765AAC12BACEFF81007:r) The American Cornerstone Institute, a nonprofit I recently founded, has created a unique survey. We're trying to gauge the state of America's Educational System by surveying people like you. I'd like to ask you to give me 2 minutes of your time so we can better understand the problems that exist in our educational system. You can access the survey here...

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/education_survey/](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60475991:JI73qzoNN:m:1:3317145305:65B50FAED582D765AAC12BACEFF81007:r) Thank you for your consideration. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Inaction is complicity
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=jA1sUzCWYGpxcd4mru%2FWL9PrVXZB%2FsT0&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
I have a message for my colleagues in Congress: If the tragedy in Uvalde, Texas, doesn't crystalize your sense of obligation to take action, then you are, in effect, putting guns above children.
Columbine. Virginia Tech. Aurora. Sandy Hook. Charleston. Orlando. Las Vegas. Parkland. Gilroy. El Paso. Buffalo. Orange County. Uvalde.
Why does the greatest nation on Earth continue to tolerate this? It is outrageous that members of Congress continue to block the kinds of reforms that would prevent more families from being torn apart by another tragedy.
Inaction is complicity.
It's long past time for Congress to match prayers with action. That means passing the legislation that has _already been proposed and blocked_ that could make a real difference: Red flag laws to remove guns from dangerous people. And the Lori Jackson Domestic Violence Survivor Protection Act to prevent domestic abusers with a restraining order from purchasing or possessing firearms. And Ethan's Law, a bill to establish requirements for safe gun storage. And laws that close gaps in the background-check system, like the Charleston Loophole - measures that an overwhelming majority of Americans support.
We need to do all of these things and more, and we need to do them right now.
To those who refuse to take a stand claiming that "it's not the time" or that action would be "too political," I say this: The gun violence epidemic **__is__** political because the elected leaders who oppose reform are the ones who continue to stand in the way of solutions - all to protect their own political careers. But every day that they fail to take action means more of the same. More lives lost. More communities devastated.
That is precisely why we cannot lose courage or heart. We cannot lose hope. We must keep standing up and speaking out until there is real, meaningful change. That is what I'll continue to do every day in the Senate, and I hope you'll be with me in this fight.
Thank you,
Dick
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.
